name: run_progen2_score
description: Score one protein sequence with the ProGen2 protein language model: the log-likelihood it assigns to the sequence, as a sum over residues (ll_sum), a per-residue mean (ll_mean) and the corresponding perplexity. Both are the average of the left-to-right and right-to-left readings, which is what ProGen2's own likelihood.py reports. Use it to rank designed sequences, compare variants of one protein, or judge how protein-like a sequence is. Higher (less negative) ll_mean means the model finds the sequence more likely. Per-residue log-probabilities are opt-in and bounded, because a long sequence is a long array; the whole array can be written to a .npy file instead.

sequence.description: One protein sequence in single-letter amino-acid code, or a single-record FASTA. ProGen2's own terminal markers are accepted: '1<seq>2' reads N to C and '2<seq>1' reads C to N. Given amino acids alone the sequence is wrapped '1<seq>2'. At most 2046 residues (progen2-base's context window is 2048 tokens).

per_token_log_prob.description: Return the log-probability of every scored token, left to right, one number per position. Refused, not clipped, above 2048 positions -- ask for 'per_token_file' instead.

per_token_file.description: Write the per-token log-probabilities to a float32 .npy file on the provider host and return its path, shape and size instead of its contents.

name: run_progen2_generate
description: Generate new protein sequences with the ProGen2 protein language model by nucleus sampling, optionally continuing a prompt. Use it to propose candidate sequences, extend a partial design, or sample a family's neighbourhood. Give 'prompt' an N-terminal fragment to condition on, or leave it out for an unconditioned sample. Output is bounded on purpose: at most 16 sequences of at most 1024 tokens each, which is what the provider's VRAM budget is declared at. Results are reproducible for a given 'seed'.

prompt.description: An N-terminal fragment to continue, in single-letter amino-acid code, or a single-record FASTA. Omit it (or give '1') to sample without conditioning. The prompt is NOT closed with a C-terminus marker, because generation continues it.

num_samples.description: How many sequences to sample (1-16). Peak GPU memory is roughly linear in num_samples x max_length.

max_length.description: Total token budget per sequence INCLUDING the prompt (ProGen2's own --max-length). At most 1024. Sampling stops early at a terminus marker.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature (ProGen2's --t; its default is 0.2, which samples conservatively). Higher is more diverse and less protein-like.

seed.description: Random seed (ProGen2's --rng-seed, default 42). The same seed and the same arguments give the same sequences.
